text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Taaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Not yet... not yet...
At this pace, the decisive moment will be...)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Right here, right now!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Burn! Stoke your fighting spirit!
Turn your inner flame into power!!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki in the lead! It is Yaeno Muteki!!
(Waaaaaaaahhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —Flame Dance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: A fighting spirit that shot straight to the heavens in an instant, blazing just like fire.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Are you consciously controlling that?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ――...Alright!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: The first leg of the Classic Triple Crown, the Satsuki Sho, has been claimed by Yaeno Muteki!
(WAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(...! Oh, right,
the Winner's Circle...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that caught me off guard!
I had no idea she could run that well—she totally flew under the radar!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: You were so cool~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
You're running in the Nippon Derby too, right?
I'm really looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (—They acknowledge my running.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (So many people came...!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Thank you very much!!

At Yaeno Muteki's speech of gratitude,
a burst of thunderous applause erupted from the stands.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ugh... ngh, uuu...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Uwaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Chiyono O-san...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Tasting defeat and lamenting your frustration
is a privilege reserved only for those who fought.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: As I am now, I am not even permitted to grieve.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"At the Japanese Derby, without fail.
I want to shine brightly on the turf too."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: No matter what price must be paid.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Trainer-dono.
choice_data_list: Congratulations on winning the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: This victory was made possible by your guidance, Trainer-dono. You have my heartfelt gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And as I stood in the Winner's Circle,
so many people offered me their praise.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Surrounded by thunderous applause, it finally truly sank in.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The path I've walked was not a mistake.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Choosing races as a place
to channel and elevate that fighting spirit, too.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That she had trained rigorously to master
and control her fiery passion through "Unity of Fire and Water."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I believe I am walking on the right path,
which is to say, I think I am growing, but..."

She used to lose control of her competitive spirit just by running neck and neck,
but now, her composure remains unbroken even on the biggest stages.

She has mastered both "Unity of Fire and Water" and race tactics,
allowing her to adapt her thinking and running
to how the race unfolds.
I told her that this was unmistakably growth.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: In that case, I intend to devote myself even further going forward.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Next is the Japanese Derby. Trainer,
I look forward to your continued support.

Back at Tracen Academy, as we were parting ways,
curiosity struck me and I asked Yaeno Muteki a question.
choice_data_list: Weren't the old folks happy about it?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "...Well, who knows? She might not know the taste of victory yet."
choice_data_list: Huh? I thought you came to watch...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
At that hour, my students have their training,
so they have not come to watch.
—That couldn't possibly be true. You ask Yaeno Muteki if this isn't supposed to be an opportunity to show her grandparents how much she's grown.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I am still an inexperienced novice in the midst of growth.
It is far too premature for you to observe my running.
choice_data_list: Even though you went through the trouble of winning the Satsuki Sho...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
As long as you keep winning,
the opportunity to watch will surely come eventually.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, until I have defeated many a formidable foe and conquered the Twinkle Series,
there is no need for you to watch me."
"Judging by how she looks, she has no intention of reporting today's results either. That's just way too lonely...!"
choice_data_list: In that case, I'll make the report.
In that case, I'll make the report.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Are you saying you need to report that
as part of your duties as Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Then I cannot stand in your way.
It would pain me to see you accused of negligence, Trainer-dono.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Please, have a seat.
Having obtained Yaeno Muteki's permission, I promptly place a phone call to her home.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, Trainer-san.
Thank you for looking after my grandchild.

After briefly explaining the circumstances behind the sudden contact,
I shared the news of Yaeno Muteki's victory in the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: ...I assume you speak no lie?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
"—No, I actually watched it on TV
during my break, but...
I still can't believe it..."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: Ooh! It really was... reality after all!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
"Just being able to run in the Satsuki Sho
was a huge honor in itself... It feels like a dream."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
"However, I see you are still only halfway there.
Your battle is far from over."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Please continue to take care of Yaeno.
May good fortune be with you both on the battlefield.

Afterward, I received words of congratulations and
gratitude from all of Yaeno Muteki's family members
before ending the call.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
............
...Trainer-dono, forgive my rudeness earlier.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Grandpa was so excited...
...To think he was... watching me...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ......Hehe, hehehe...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Alright!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Encouraged by their words, I'll go into the Japanese Derby with everything I've got to claim victory!
